{{Term/Store|Jabu-Jabu's Belly||Series, OoA}} is the seventh [[Dungeon]] in {{OoA}}.<ref>{{Cite Book|quote= |book= E |publisher= |page= 152}}</ref>

==Entrance to the Belly==
[[File:OoA Jabu-Jabu's Belly.png|left|frame]]
As the name would indicate, the [[Dungeon]] is set inside the body of [[Lord Jabu-Jabu|Jabu-Jabu]], guardian of the [[Zora]]s.<ref>{{Cite|Jabu-Jabu is the guardian of us Zoras!|King Zora|OoA}}</ref> To enter Jabu's Jabu's Belly, [[Link]] must first obtain permission from [[King Zora]].<ref>{{Cite|My permission is needed to enter Jabu-Jabu, but I can't permit just anyone to see our guardian.|King Zora|OoA}}</ref> To receive permission, Link must first rid the [[Zora Seas]] of the filthy seawater, which has left Jabu-Jabu near death.<ref>{{Cite|The filthy seawater has left Jabu-Jabu near death. If you say you must, then find a way to get rid of this filthy seawater and save Jabu-Jabu.|King Zora|OoA}}</ref> This is done by using the [[Fairy Powder]] to lift the curse set by [[Veran]] on the [[Fairy Queen]].<ref>{{Cite|You may not believe this, but I am the Queen Fairy, guardian of this sea! The curse of an evil one named Veran has made me appear so! The magic of Fairy Powder can turn me back to normal.|Fairy Queen|OoA}}</ref> The Fairy Queen will then cleanse the seas,<ref>{{Cite|Thank you, young one! Now I can cleanse the seas of evil!|Fairy Queen|OoA}}</ref> allowing Link to enter Jabu-Jabu's Belly.

Link can only enter Jabu-Jabu's Belly in the present time, as Jabu-Jabu is too small in the past.<ref>{{Cite|You wish to enter Jabu-Jabu? I wish I could tell you to do as you please, but Jabu-Jabu is still young. He's too small to go inside him.|King Zora|OoA}}</ref>

==Themes and Navigation==
Although located within a living being, Jabu-Jabu's Belly is superficially similar to any other [[Dungeon]] in the game, except that the walls are covered in small pores that open and close. The Dungeon consists of three different floors. On the third floor, [[Link]] will find three [[Floor Switch]]es that can raise or lower the [[Water (Terrain)|Water]] level in the dungeon. Jabu Jabu's Belly features two side-scrolling areas, one of which containing [[Angler Fish]], the [[Miniboss]] of the Dungeon. In this Dungeon, [[Link]] will obtain the [[Long Hook]], an upgrade of the [[Switch Hook]]. This [[Item]] is essential in the navigation of the Dungeon, and is required to access the lair of the Dungeon's [[Boss]], [[Plasmarine]]. Once [[Link]] defeats [[Plasmarine]] in an underwater battle, he will receive a [[Heart Container]] as well as the seventh [[Essences of Time|Essence of Time]], the [[Rolling Sea]].

When placed one below the other on a two-dimensional plane, the three main floors of the Dungeon form the shape of a [[Fish]].
